text: Access to structured labeled data determines which industries can capitalize on AI first: finance and healthcare hold a head start, while transportation and customer service face hurdles from privacy concerns, data fragmentation, and extensive labeling requirements.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Learning - Decentralized Governance to Optimize Human Output Datasets for AI Learning (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4755632

isBasedOn.name: AI Learning - Decentralized Governance to Optimize Human Output Datasets for AI Learning

abstract: Industries that can access large volumes of structured and labeled data, such as finance and healthcare, may have a head start in leveraging AI. On the other hand, industries like transportation and customer service may face hurdles in obtaining quality data

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: applies to industries seeking to realize AI driven market potential
